subject: [PATCH RFC nfs-utils v2 05/10] nfsdctl: register nfsd listeners with rpcbind

2026-09-14.patch_summary: This patch modifies the nfsdctl utility to register NFS and NFSACL listeners with rpcbind in a more asynchronous manner, avoiding a deadlock that occurred when a slow rpcbind blocked other NFSD netlink commands. The patch detects support for this new behavior by checking for a specific attribute in LISTENER_SET, and it clears all existing entries before registering the new ones. This approach ensures that the registration is only attempted after the reply from rpcbind has been parsed, preventing potential issues with incomplete registrations.
